wrap_layer_with_lora: wrap a linear layer with LoRA support using wrap_with_lora_layer for column, row, or merged parallel linear
merge_lora_weights: merge LoRA adapter weights into the base layer weights in-place for inference speedup
unmerge_lora_weights: unmerge LoRA weights to restore the original base layer weights for training
set_lora_weights: set LoRA A and B weight tensors on a layer with optional strength and multi-adapter support
replace_submodule: replace a submodule in a PyTorch model by dot-separated name with a new module
